question: The momentum of an object of mass 'm' moving with a velocity 'v' is given by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**mv**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Momentum:**

 
 
• The **momentum, p **of an object is defined as the** product of its mass, m, and velocity, V**.
 
• **Momentum = Mass x Velocity**
 
• That is,** p = mv. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• Momentum has both direction and ma
